candidates.hook: High Priest breaks a wax seal and declares: 'By Royal command, this sanctuary is placed under immediate Crown seizure.'
candidates.cliffhanger: The High Priest brandishes the letter and states: 'Three years later, the beggar is revealed to be a Duke. The marriage does not rise with him.'
candidates.why: Immediate legal threat and public humiliation of the 'Duke' status creates high stakes; the viewer needs to know if the marriage is valid.
candidates.context_needed: None. The conflict is clear: Priest vs. Couple, marriage validity at stake.

candidates.hook: High Priest thrusts document at camera: '...because as far as the Crown knew, Alexander Ashburton was already dead.'
candidates.cliffhanger: High Priest smirks and delivers the final blow: 'Love doesn't make a Duchess, girl. Paper does.'
candidates.why: The reveal that the Duke was 'dead' is a massive plot twist that invalidates the marriage, followed by a cruel dismissal that leaves the audience angry and wanting a comeback.
candidates.context_needed: Viewer needs to know Alexander is the Duke and Juliana is his bride, which is established in the first few seconds of the clip via the Priest's dialogue.

candidates.hook: Alexander glares with icy authority: 'Then let it prove that in ten days, before witnesses. Not with six halberds pointed at me in my own chapel.'
candidates.cliffhanger: Guards surround Alexander with halberds pointed at his chest as he roars: 'Lower them! Or explain to the Crown why its own bailiffs raised iron on the Duke it just confirmed!'
candidates.why: High tension standoff. The Duke stands his ground against armed guards, creating a 'will he win?' cliffhanger that demands the next episode to see the outcome of the confrontation.
candidates.context_needed: Viewer needs to know the marriage is being challenged, which is implied by the 'Duke' title and the aggressive guards.

moments.desc: High Priest breaks wax seal and declares the sanctuary under Crown seizure.
High Priest reveals Alexander was considered dead by the Crown, invalidating the marriage.
High Priest dismisses Juliana's love, stating 'Love doesn't make a Duchess, girl. Paper does.'
Guards point halberds at Alexander's chest as he threatens to explain to the Crown why they raised iron on the Duke.
